events.title: an England versus Rest of the World XI match is staged to mark the centenary of The Football Association . Against a star-studded opposition team containing Alfredo Di Stéfano , Ferenc Puskás , Denis Law , 레프 야신 and Eusébio , England won 2–1 with goals from Terry Paine and Jimmy Greaves , while Denis Law scored for the Rest of the World.
